notes.title: Cones in Space 3.9

What's going on CONERS. Another amazing cones in space update is ready for you all! This update doesn't add any content, but has drastically improved the quality of the game and has hopefully fixed all the performance issues people were facing. Peep the changelog:

-further optimized gameplay
-menus now run at framerate set in settings
-fixed blood overlay not appearing on hud correctly
-cursor no longer stretches weirdly in certain menus
-fixed blood toxicity timer ignoring framerate
-fixed conx's timer ignoring framerate
-fixed cone falling too fast when entering
	dungeons
-fixed cone's mishap in the grass dungeon
	playing really fast on higher framerates
-fixed cone's animations playing too fast
	on higher framerates
-fixed planet weather effects being crazy multiplied while
	on higher framerates
-fixed autumn leaves falling too fast on higher framerates
-fixed wormhole cutscene playing too fast on higher framerates
-fixed cone cash dispenser dispensing cash too fast
-fixed cone cash mode enemies spawning too quickly
-fixed cone cash mode waves progressing too quickly
-fixed space pirate ship floors not having the correct area
-redid many menu buttons
-fixed some menu buttons not responding to the cursor
-fixed gallery display not slowing down on higher framerates
-fixed hammer break timer not scaling to framerate
-changed transparency of hotbar
-fixed objects behind cone and in front of the third person
	camera not rendering
-redid 3d collisions

Additionally, for the next few months updates may slow down so we can work more on our next project, which is also cone related. After that we'll resume normal update development. Thanks for reading and enjoy the update!

notes.title: 3.5 devlog
notes.content:
I know its been a while since the last cones in space update, but dont fret! We are still working tirelessly to provide coney updates to this game.

So far we have made great progress on the cones in space update! The game has been fully ported to gamemaker studio 2 and is basically the same as how it previously was, now we are focused on adding new content.

So far we have nearly completed the deep sea diving, and have finished reworking the final boss! Now all whats left for us to do is:

-finish adding new planets (2/4)
-finish ocean stuff (almost complete)

stay tuned! And I hope this update will be worth the wait.

notes.title: The ACTUAL last update before the engine switch
notes.content: this is a small update for cones in space, mainly fixes a few major issues with the game, like one of the bugs fixed made it literally impossible to beat the game. A button for the save converter was also added to the main menu! Anyway, the next cones in space update will be in gamemaker studio 2, stay tuned!

notes.title: THE END IS NEAR!
notes.content:
Firstly, thanks to everyone who has played cones in space and has stuck with the game, whether you have been here since 1.0, or found the game through its recent steam release. thanks.

There is a big change coming to cones in space, we are switching its engine to gamemaker studio 2 so we can continue to make new features in the future, and make the game available to more devices and people.

This is the final update made with gamemaker 8.

We have added a save converter tool (in local files) that will let you convert any save you want into one compatible with the gamemaker studio 2 version.

Don't fret! The save converter and gm8 version of cones in space will be available as a separate build in settings.

Once again, thanks to everyone that has played cones in space so far, and hopefully you will enjoy the game for years to come!

notes.title: Cones in space 3.4.2 + news
notes.content:
Cones in space 3.4.2 is here! this is mostly just fixing bugs but a notice to all players:

Cones in space is being ported to gamemaker studio 2!
This is to remove some of the jankiness like obs not working with it, it crashing for no reason on some devices, and exports to mac and linux! Unfortunately it does come with a few drawbacks

due to removal of functions in gamemaker studio 2 the following will need to be removed:
-debug console
-mods
-custom textures in the planet creator

The save data will also be completely reworked for the new engine, but dont fret! A tool will be added to the old version to convert your save when the time comes.

When the gamemaker studio 2 version releases, a legacy build will still be available. We hope you all enjoy the cones in space updates for years to come!

notes.title: Major update devlog 1
notes.content:
what's up coners? the new major update for cones in space! In this handy dandy steam update I will inform you all on the coney goodness we have in store for you in the coming future...

[b]The combat system in cones in space is getting reworked![/b]
lets face it.. the combat is complete garbage, so I've revamped the entire thing, and have added sound effects for when you hit something! the environment also reacts to you breaking stuff down so the game will hopefully feel more alive, critical hits have been added as well! Every time you hit an enemy there's a 1 in 30 chance of getting a critical hit, however some items will allow you to increase this chance or get guaranteed crits 

[b]new planets![/b]
a significant amount of new planets are being added! Really no new planets have been added since 2.5 so it's something that's long overdue

that's all the beanage I'm spilling for this post! Stay tuned for one of the top ten greatest cones in space updates of all time...
